patch_description: Reorganizes the ansatz into a staged phase–entanglement–mixing architecture. Graph-symmetric parameter sharing reduces the block to 14 independent parameters, while all allowed interaction links remain represented. The peripheral [1,8] and [4,8] CZ gates are replaced by independently trainable CRZ gates, and placing an entanglement stage before the RY layer creates noncommuting feature mixing without increasing the overall gate count substantially.
